name: DexVault
author: Renault John Lecoultre
description: Tells DexVault what every account plays, and each account's stars and hearts every hour

users.reason: Report the plays, stars and hearts of the accounts assigned to the plugin

subsonicapi.reason: Read each account's stars and hearts, which Navidrome keeps per account

scheduler.reason: Report the stars and hearts every hour

http.reason: Send the reports to DexVault, which runs beside Navidrome on the home network

url.title: DexVault address
url.description: Where Navidrome reaches DexVault; on the same Docker network, http://dexvault:3001

token.title: Token
token.description: The same secret as NAVIDROME_PLUGIN_TOKEN in the DexVault stack
